_note: Byte ceilings. reference_max_bytes and corpus_max_bytes are tripwires, not caps: they do not forbid growth, they force it to stop and be accounted for here before it lands. Raise either only together with a line in _history saying what the growth bought. Lower them whenever reduction lands.
_history: v0.2.0+unreleased baseline: ja-JP 74189, en-US 74259.
Content reduction: ja-JP 72292, en-US 72675. Removed the preamble repeated in ten reference files and cut restatement from 02 and 10.

Structural: split methods/system-selection.md into selection + framework-application. Largest reference 14509 -> 11856 (ja-JP), both halves under the 100-line reference guideline, at a cost of 670 bytes (ja-JP) and 702 (en-US) in headers, cross-pointers, and router rows. Corpus ja-JP 72962, en-US 73377.

Content growth, deliberate: ja-JP 78048, en-US 78109 (+5086 / +4732). Bought the method's stated purpose, which the text did not previously carry — an openness precondition on activation that a closed problem space fails, stopping decided by exhaustion of material rather than by cost, cost handed to the human as their call, a fourth framework use (transition model) with its procedure, and the statement that a count guards against overclaiming rather than measuring value. Largest reference 11856 -> 14380 (ja-JP), still 80 lines.

Content growth, from a defect the method found in itself: ja-JP 78233, en-US 78261 (+185 / +152). A controlled run in an open problem space listed a preserved item and then broke it, because item 12 of 09-evaluation-and-domains checked that the list was written and never that the finished work honoured it. Item 12 now audits the list item by item and requires an unhonoured item to be reported as unhonoured.

Content growth, from a second defect: ja-JP 78879, en-US 78818 (+646 / +557). Handing cost-based cutoff to the human makes an interrupted run the normal case, and nothing said what its output is worth — so a run stopped by a usage limit was read as a converged result. 00-activation now states that a pass cut short from outside is not a pass that stopped, forbids judging increment at the point of interruption, and requires an unresumed handover to name itself unconverged and list the untried moves.

Reduction, by excision: ja-JP 78879 -> 71939, en-US 78818 -> 72211 (-8.8% / -8.4%). The skill is capability grounded in cultural frameworks; value judgments that do not support that capability were removed and relocated to the caller's context document. Retired 07-creative-patterns entirely (its layered-framework clause moved into 03). 00-principles-and-constraints lost three of four perspectives and four of five constraints, and became a statement of attribution and rule justification; the conflict-resolution authority moved to the core principle in ROUTER.

Content growth, deliberate, developed in parallel on origin/main from the pre-excision 78233/78261 baseline and reconciled here: bought two things the text carried procedurally but never told anyone to reach for. Layering orthogonal frameworks was written entirely as risk, and a second framework was gated as an exception -- admitted when the first could not handle an information type; it now names the intersections of two grids as a source of structure no single framework yields, with orthogonality kept as the condition rather than the gate. The temporal and transition models sat as two uses among four with no reason to prefer them; they now say what placement cannot show. The transition procedure gained a fifth step keeping each factor's trajectory separate, because collapsing the factors averages away that different ones took different routes at different times. Paid for in part by removing the instruction to open without framework names when the audience's interest is unknown, which withheld the value source before it had been tried.

Merge of the two lines above: this branch's excision (down to 71939/72211) combined with origin's parallel growth from the pre-excision baseline. Measured after merging both sets of source changes: ja-JP 72902, en-US 73106. reference_max_bytes carried over unchanged at 14857/14566 (framework-application.md, already the largest reference on both sides).

Content growth, deliberate: ja-JP 72902 -> 75356, en-US 73106 -> 75900 (+2454 / +2794). Bought an explicit candidate-recall path between abstract probe and framework preview, plus structurally diverse search anchors for state grids, cycles/calendars, paths/flows, directions, and layers. The named cultural systems are retrieval anchors rather than embedded framework knowledge or adoption recommendations; detailed structure remains dynamically sourced and checked when used.

Build-link normalization: ja-JP 75356 -> 75366, en-US 75900 -> 75910 (+10 / +10). Router references now use source module paths so build-time link rewriting produces valid references/ paths in generated skills.

Build-link normalization, completed across Router loading-order references: ja-JP 75366 -> 75386, en-US 75910 -> 75930 (+20 / +20). Pre-existing bare module filenames in loading-order prose were normalized to source module paths so replace_router_links() can rewrite every generated skill reference into references/.

Author-authority runtime rebaseline: measured current source ja-JP 75217 -> 77571, en-US 74114 -> 76461 (+2354 / +2347). Bought an explicit separation between recording/state semantics and decision authority, moved use scope/loading depth/stopping/adoption back to requester or delegated execution context, and converted former autonomous stop/applicability rules into observable signals.

Delegated method-boundary rebaseline: ja-JP 77571 -> 79916, en-US 76461 -> 78790 (+2345 / +2329). Bought the same decision-authority boundary at method level: framework rejection and Taiheki activation gates became observable/delegated states; intent inference is preserved with explicit evidence-state separation instead of a blanket ban; orthogonal multi-framework composition is reopened while attribution safeguards remain; fixed enumeration and stop prerequisites return to external use conditions or delegated judgment.

Framework-attribution rebaseline: ja-JP 79916 -> 80844, en-US 78790 -> 79875 (+928 / +1085). Bought framework-application semantics that admit discrete and continuous position structures, replace a fixed two-pass assignment rule with reproducibility testing appropriate to the convention, preserve failed derivations as unresolved/exploratory material instead of discarding them wholesale, and keep unfalsifiable attribution claims from becoming target-supported without making framework rejection an automatic skill decision.

KJ return-check reproducibility rebaseline: ja-JP 80844 -> 81121, en-US 79875 -> 80147 (+277 / +272). Traced the fixed two-pass return-check rule to an AI-evaluation experiment (e5443f5), not the KJ primary-source lineage; kept return-to-material and label-vs-group diagnosis while replacing the borrowed fixed repetition count with independence-increasing reruns appropriate to the case, and marked the rerun method explicitly as a generative-AI-era adaptation.

KJ gap-check count reduction: ja-JP 81121 -> 81112, en-US 80147 -> 80142 (-9 / -5). Traced the fixed one-pass oversight check to the 2026-08-23 relaxation (3988e12), not to the KJ primary-source lineage; removed only the arbitrary repetition count while preserving both gap-seeking and the prohibition on inventing gaps. Corpus tripwires ratcheted down by the same reductions.

KJ card-metadata boundary rebaseline: ja-JP 81112 -> 81441, en-US 80142 -> 80499 (+329 / +357). Traced the fixed four-field schema to modern research-hygiene work (fe49a56), not KJ primary-source requirements; kept source/path/stage/collector-time as standard provenance metadata, allowed additional nonsemantic provenance/admin fields when needed, and preserved the prohibition on preclassification fields that steer later reading or grouping. EN corpus tripwire raised to accommodate the documented growth; JA remains within its existing tripwire.

KJ return-addition list openness rebaseline: ja-JP 81441 -> 81519, en-US 80499 -> 80572 (+78 / +73). Traced the return-check list to modern handoff/AI-evaluation work (0499918, e5443f5, 1f36b8e), where four addition patterns later became five; kept the recurring patterns as useful checks while making explicit that they are not exhaustive, and marked the list itself as a generative-AI-era adaptation. JA corpus tripwire raised to accommodate the documented growth; EN remains within its existing tripwire.

KJ cover-and-raise lineage correction: ja-JP 81519 -> 81519, en-US 80572 -> 80543 (+0 / -29). The lineage audit showed that cover-and-raise entered as an unverified modern adaptation (0499918), while later evaluation measured both benefit and cost without establishing KJ-primary-source lineage. Reattributed the procedure from attested KJ practice to the generative-AI-era adaptation list without changing runtime behavior or inventing a selection criterion. EN corpus tripwire ratcheted down by the 29-byte reduction; JA remains unchanged.

KJ primary-product scope rebaseline: ja-JP 81519 -> 81567, en-US 80543 -> 80577 (+48 / +34). Traced the statement that blank discovery is the procedure's primary product to the initial no-technique comparison (0c19f04), where synthesis quality did not separate the arms but blank detection did. Kept blank discovery as a useful emergent capability while restoring the broader KJ purpose of raising a whole picture from fragments; blanks are no longer a mandatory or privileged product. Existing corpus tripwires still contain the documented growth.

KJ placement-order rebaseline: ja-JP 81567 -> 81691, en-US 80577 -> 80688 (+124 / +111). The placement audit found primary-source support for whole-picture emergence and for noticing missing material during placement, while the same source explicitly frames synthesis as bottom-up rather than top-down. Replaced the opaque 'draw relationships not drawn' wording with recording relations or blanks that become visible in placement, and removed the universal whole-first / reverse-grouping drawing order. No new fixed sequence, count, stop, or success criterion was introduced; existing corpus tripwires still contain the growth.

KJ narration-order rebaseline: ja-JP 81691 -> 81895, en-US 80688 -> 80910 (+204 / +222). Traced the absolute ban on narration order absent from the diagram to the initial AI adaptation (0c19f04), where the same file already carried two-way diagram/narration cross-checking. Kept A-type diagram as the grounding source for B-type narration, but let newly noticed ordering or relations return to the diagram and source material for validation rather than suppressing them at generation time. Supported additions can update the diagram; unsupported ones remain explicitly hypothetical, unresolved, or narrative convenience. Existing corpus tripwires still contain the growth.

KJ single-resistance diagnosis rebaseline: ja-JP 81895 -> 81940, en-US 80910 -> 80949 (+45 / +39). Traced the immediate 'one resisting fragment means the label or grouping is wrong' rule to the initial AI adaptation (0c19f04). Primary-source and 1997-based practice support returning to data and checking interpretive deviation, but not that binary fixed threshold. Kept every resistance as a mandatory recheck signal while widening diagnosis to label, grouping, card boundary, or source reading and avoiding cause assignment from resistance alone. Existing corpus tripwires still contain the growth.

Iteration stop-authority rebaseline: ja-JP 81940 -> 82015, en-US 80949 -> 80997 (+75 / +48). Traced the autonomous stop rule to delayed-round orchestration (4771053) and its later conclusion-movement measurement (f888f9b). Kept stalled target-side movement as an observable stop signal and kept residual/reopening preservation, but removed the static rule's authority to close a round. Closing now follows external use conditions or discretion delegated to the executing AI, completing the decision-authority boundary established in PR #193. Corpus tripwires raised only enough to account for this documented boundary change.

Externalization-authority rebaseline: ja-JP 82015 -> 82048, en-US 80997 -> 81032 (+33 / +35). Traced collection-vs-publishing threshold separation to the suppression-loosening change in 10205bb, where the purpose was to keep weak signals from being discarded at collection time, not to define a universal CSW responsibility gate. Kept distinct collection and externalization thresholds while returning publication/execution thresholds to domain criteria, external use conditions, or delegated discretion, consistent with PR #193. Existing corpus tripwires still contain the growth.

Evaluation misfit-authority rebaseline: ja-JP 82048 -> 82048, en-US 81032 -> 81043 (+0 / +11). Traced reject/background/hold handling to modern runtime design (278fd36, 3dc8777), where the invariant was to keep framework completion from rewriting the target and adoption states were introduced as decision-provenance vocabulary. Kept misfit visible and target material unchanged while returning the choice of adoption state to its recorded actor and basis, consistent with PR #193. Existing corpus tripwires still contain the change.

Governance rule-remediation order rebaseline: ja-JP 82048 -> 82051, en-US 81043 -> 81048 (+3 / +5). Traced the narrow-condition -> lower-priority -> auxiliary -> removal sequence to the unmeasured v0.1.0 initial design (cd58044); later work preserved or compressed it without comparing that order. Kept all four remediation options, the requirement to identify a rule's function before removal, and the prohibition on deleting dynamic material as a substitute for rule maintenance, while removing the unsupported fixed ordering. Existing corpus tripwires still contain the change.

Working-window foreground-set rebaseline: ja-JP 82051 -> 82003, en-US 81048 -> 81028 (-48 / -20). Traced the four-item foreground list to the v40 integration (3dc8777), where it was introduced with preservation-vs-attention separation but not tested as a closed set; delayed-round work (4771053) strengthened reopening and residual retention without validating the limit. Kept selective foregrounding and the four recurring examples while reopening the working set to whatever current work requires. Corpus tripwires ratcheted down by the same reductions.

Cognitive-stance read-cadence rebaseline: ja-JP 82003 -> 81961, en-US 81028 -> 80975 (-42 / -53). Traced the fixed once-per-round load and same-round reload ban to the unmeasured cognitive-stance rollout (e2688b8, 88265fe); PR #84 explicitly did not measure prompt wording effects. Kept the cognitive stance as a cross-cutting capability and retained need-based return when existing explanations or rules outrank the target, while removing the arbitrary read count. Corpus tripwires ratcheted down by the same reductions.

Transformation missing-element list openness restoration: ja-JP 81961 -> 81967, en-US 80975 -> 80993 (+6 / +18). Restored the v0.1.0 non-exhaustive semantics that were originally stated at file level and later lost when the general preamble was removed in 3988e12. Kept the four recurring distinctions unchanged while allowing target-specific additional cases; no new fixed category was introduced. The existing JA tripwire contains the growth; the EN tripwire was raised by the same 18-byte growth.

Transformation relationship-type list openness restoration: ja-JP 81967 -> 82003, en-US 80993 -> 81051 (+36 / +58).
